subject: Urgent: Summit hub network failure + cracked demo mast — mitigation & credits
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acmeretail.com>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@venuetech.io>
Date: 2026-09-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Summit — immediate onsite incident: network down & demo mast damage

Team — quick status from the floor: our demo island (H-12) just lost upstream connectivity and the vertical mast on the left demo pod (corner post) has a visible crack — looks like it was bumped during rigging. Venue PDU tripped and the switch feeding multiple islands went into err-disabled.

Impact: live demos down (no remote models), scheduled 10:15 product walkthrough with Acme is at risk. Onsite tech says they can try to power-cycle but might need a replacement switch or a local router. I attached a quick photo of the crack and the venue PDU snapshot (venue_pdu_logs.pdf).

Asks: 1) Dylan — can we spin up a mobile 5G router (vendor quote attached) and route critical demo traffic? 2) Stephanie — if we can’t restore in 30 mins, can we move Acme’s walkthrough to the adjacent booth (K-9) and run a telepresence fallback for the speaker? 3) Tessa — can you approve a same-day hardware spend up to $750 if needed?

I’m on the floor at Booth H-12. I’ll update status every 10 mins.

—Vanessa
Marketing Field Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@venuetech.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summit — immediate onsite incident: network down & demo mast damage

Vanessa — we see the PDU reported a surge at 08:07 and the switch port group went into err-disabled. Venue tech attempted a soft-reset; the switch requires a full replacement to guarantee stability. We can:

- Deploy a loaner managed switch (15–25 mins) + patch cable; or
- Provide a mobile 5G bond router as a temporary uplink (immediate; requires vendor account and local auth).

We can also dispatch our maintenance crew to assess the mast — from the photo it looks like an external clamp failure; we have spare clamps and can secure the pole safely in ~20 mins.

If you want the 5G option now I can hand off to Marco (Markus Supplies) who has routers on site. Cost for same-day rental + activation: $420 incl. tax (invoice to follow).

—Aaron
Venue Operations, VenueTech
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@venuetech.io>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summit — immediate onsite incident: network down & demo mast damage

Thanks — Vanessa, please push the Acme walkthrough to K-9 if they can accept the slight location change (Jamie, can you confirm?).

We’ll take the 5G bond now to restore demos immediately. Marco/Markus: please proceed with the rental and activation; charge to RDW corporate card on file and forward invoice (Marco: marco@markussupplies.com). I’m authorizing up to $750 for same-day fixes — Tessa, please confirm approval for this one-off spend.

Operational notes:
- I’ll route the demo VM traffic through the 5G router and pin the model endpoints to the local edge instance to reduce stall.
- Stephanie, help coordinate AV on-site to mirror HDMI to the K-9 display and set up a camera for the speaker telepresence if they prefer to stay put.

—Dylan
Program Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acmeretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@venuetech.io>
Date: 2026-09-02T08:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summit — immediate onsite incident: network down & demo mast damage

Vanessa / Dylan — K-9 is fine for us, happy to move 10:15 there. Our team will help carry gear. Thanks for the rapid response.

If you end up needing a partial credit for setup disruptions we can discuss — priority is the session.

—Jamie Collins
Partnerships, Acme Retail
From: Marco Ruiz <marco@markussupplies.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@venuetech.io>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Summit — immediate onsite incident: network down & demo mast damage

On behalf of Markus Supplies — we’ve activated the 5G bond router and delivered to H-12. Attached is the invoice (5g-router-invoice.pdf). Router is online and I confirm WAN sessions are established (we see stable >200Mbps aggregate).

We also supplied a clamp kit and a field tech to secure the mast; minor cosmetic crack should not affect demo stability. If you want, we can replace the pole tomorrow during teardown.

—Marco Ruiz
Markus Supplies (field ops)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@tessamorgan.com>
Cc: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@acmeretail.com>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@venuetech.io>, Marco Ruiz <marco@markussupplies.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Summit — immediate onsite incident: network down & demo mast damage — post-mortem and credits

Team — quick resolution summary for the record:
- Timeline: 08:07 surge -> 08:22 venue triage -> 08:35 RDW approved 5G rental -> 09:03 5G live -> 10:10 Acme session moved to K-9 and completed.
- Technical: 5G bond router kept demo traffic stable (avg 180–220 Mbps). Venue replaced the errth port in the switch rack overnight; logs attached (venue_pdu_logs.pdf).
- Physical: Markus Supplies secured mast with clamp kit; cosmetic replacement scheduled for teardown tomorrow. Photos attached (stand_photo_1.jpg).
- Finance: Marco’s invoice received for $420; Dylan authorized charge to corporate card. Tessa confirmed approval in the thread for up to $750.
- Follow-ups: 1) File for a partial sponsorship credit with Acme (Jamie, suggested amount?) 2) Post-event Ops RCA in JIRA-EVENTS-879 (Dylan to own) 3) Update the booth rigging checklist to include quick disconnect guards for vertical masts (Stephanie to draft).

Thanks everyone for the fast reactions — saved the session and kept Acme happy. I’ll upload final photos and the vendor receipts to the shared drive link: https://drive.google.com/rdw/summit-telemetry

—Vanessa
Marketing Field Ops | Redwood Inference
